model_reasoning: This alert indicates a high-severity DNS query for coinhive.com, a domain historically linked to cryptomining services. Potential explanations include active cryptomining activity (True Positive), legitimate scanning/auditing (False Positive), or benign browsing (Benign).
alignment_reasoning: Both SPLs target network DNS logs containing 'coinhive.com' within the stream:dns sourcetype, capturing the core event triggering the alert.

hypotheses.description: Host BSTOLL-L initiated outbound network connections to known cryptomining pools (e.g., stratum+tcp://pool.mine.xmr) immediately following DNS resolution of coinhive.com, consuming >50% CPU resources.
Security team performed authorized vulnerability scans using tools that resolved coinhive.com during testing, generating identical DNS logs matching the alert criteria.
User accessed a news site referencing cryptocurrency mining trends, triggering a single DNS query for coinhive.com unrelated to actual mining activity.
